verdicts.reason: A breaks the design into pieces across the banner. The photo is a tiny cropped sliver, two purple panels sit empty, and the yellow bar floats alone. 'Your personal' and the MUSINA.FR brand URL are gone, and large white gaps are left between the pieces. Only the FITNESS TRAINER headline stays readable, wedged into a narrow purple block. B is the original poster shrunk into a small column in the middle of the canvas, with about 85% of the banner left blank. Its 'Your personal' line and URL are unreadably small and the headline is only a few pixels tall: a pure shrink with no rearranging. Both are unusable. A is marginally less bad only because its headline can be read.
